verdict.rationale: Smithery's own docs say every published MCP server gets a generated typed TypeScript SDK. A Vercel AI SDK integration page also describes Smithery handling OAuth and connection management while aggregating tools from multiple servers. The evidence is thin, though: one line about generated TypeScript SDKs and nothing on other languages or packages. missing for 10: a documented core Smithery client SDK (package name, install, API reference), multi-language SDK coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Every MCP server published on Smithery gets a typed TypeScript SDK generated from its tool and trigger schemas.
Smithery handles OAuth, token refresh, and connection management automatically.
Connect to multiple servers and aggregate their tools
